limitations: Six purposive questions are descriptive, not powered for superiority/p-values/generalization.
Graph development repositories and Orbit/pulsar held-out repositories are disjoint within this study, but all three were inspected in prior work; no unseen-repository generalization.
Different installed plugin plus shipped skill treatment, not a successful extension/relabel of old 24+16 episodes.

Questions chosen from source, never graph results. Semantic and additional-symbol judgments are attributed reviewer/operator review (agent or human), not automated truth. Name actual reviewers/operators and preserve honest custody. Blind arms where possible; record any unblinding.

Offline source export, private installation inspection, exact provider/tool/runner/backend/inventory/skill pinning and concrete request-plan preparation are authorized before source-transfer approval. A plainly pending approval_reference is valid for offline runtime freeze and grants no provider/source-transfer authority. The operator obtains explicit approval only after the concrete plan is reviewable; approval and qualified-runtime evidence gate live execution and remain external custody records bound to the freeze hash.
Hash seals establish local integrity, not authentication or capture origin; require operator custody and external pre-run freeze.
Historical source pins stay unchanged; repaired runtime binary qualification (including ORB-13783) gates later live execution.
Installed v1 was unscorable: all twelve attempts retained failed/broker_failed; none are reused, rescored or replaced here.

safe-tool-text-v1 preserves original file/blob identity while masking credential-shaped/host-value text before observation. Required excerpts are checked unchanged under shape masking. No transformed quotation receives automatic source credit; host-specific masking of a required excerpt is a pre-execution admission blocker, not a truth waiver.

Only offline protocol and corpus are frozen here. Runtime model/settings, executables, four harness hashes, installed inventory/skill and source view must be observed and frozen by the operator before output.

limitations: Trait-qualified <Selector as FromStr>::from_str is source-supported but absent from frozen aliases and additional identity recognition.
Python READ_ATTEMPTS assignment is a real constant but frozen declaration recognition requires fn/def/class/const/static/struct/enum.
The shared additional-symbol checker rejects duplicate leaf names even with distinct owner qualification; this affects overlaps and ParsedScope::parse.
Rust methods written with dot owner separators do not meet the frozen Rust :: name contract.
Trait impl owner recognition in shared support checking cannot admit Selector::from_str through impl FromStr for Selector.
These are limitations of the strict frozen identity score; semantic pass and exact required-identity/citation metrics remain separate. No unsupported entry is automatically a hallucination.
